name: Maximilien Roi
title: Maximilien Roi (MAXRØ), pianist and producer in London
description: Pianist and producer in London, studying Music Production, Performance and Business at the University of Westminster. Looking for part-time work or an internship.
intro: Pianist and producer in London, in my second year of Music Production, Performance and Business at the University of Westminster.
lookingFor: I'm looking for part-time work or an internship as a studio assistant, producer, piano teacher, or in social media or events.
languages: French (native), English (fluent), some Spanish and Russian.

production.title: Production
production.intro: I work in Logic Pro and FL Studio, and do my own MIDI programming and mixing. I also do live sound.

society.title: Music Society & events
society.intro: I'm President and founder of the Westminster Music Society, with Jasper Hazell as Vice-President and Bradley Fletcher as Treasurer. I started it to get music students from different years and courses working together. This is what we've done so far, newest first.
